QuestInfo.name: Lost in Translation 2
QuestInfo.0: I should see if John needs my help with anything...
QuestInfo.1: After showing John the #bCoded Communique#k that Jack gave me, John used a #t4031680# to try to decipher the symbols... to no avail.  While John attempts to fix and recalibrate the #t4031680#s to work on these symbols, he asked me to show the letter around to the #bother experts in town#k.  Maybe they can shine some light on all this...
QuestInfo.2: I told John about Elpam's translation, and John was able to fill in some more of the blanks for me.  I need to get this new information Jack and see what else he knows...

item.0: I'm still trying to get these confounding #t4031680#s to work! Have you spoken to the others in NLC? No? Hop to it, then! We can't let Jack down. #bProfessor Foxwit#k, #bMayor Slimm#k, or #bLita#k might all know something about this. Who knows, maybe even the #bGlimmer Man#k or #bElpam#k may have come across this writing before! Cover all the angles, kid!
